text:
Alex M: Heading into today's swing shift (08:00-16:00 PST). I'll be primary for the next 8h. Jorge P is secondary. Quick notes: there's a planned deploy at 10:30am (low risk), and a known flaky KV replica in eu-west — see runbook link below.

oncall-bot: Scheduled deploy reminder: service/redwood-api deploy at 10:30 UTC. If errors > 5% for 3 consecutive minutes, open incident.

Jorge P: noted. I can cover the 12:00-12:30 UTC stand — Alex, you ok to take the pager until then?

Alex M: yes, I'll cover. Coverage gap after 15:30 PST — I have a calendar conflict 15:30-15:50, Jorge can be primary then.

Hema R: adding escalation matrix refresh: - Sev3 (functional degradation, non-blocking customer impact): page primary. If no ack in 2m, page secondary. If >15m still unresolved or repeat alerts -> page oncall-lead (@Hema R) and create incident channel. - Sev2 (partial outage, customer impact): page primary + oncall-lead immediately. - Sev1 (service down/major outage): page primary, oncall-lead, and Eng Director. Always add incident bot annotation `#incident` when creating channel. :rotating_light:

Priya S: adding runbook pointers for KV replica flaps: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/kv-replica-flap. TL;DR: check replica health, run `replica-promote --check <replica-id>`, inspect recent `kv_repl_rs` logs. If promote fails, failover with controlled window and notify CS.

Alex M: copying quick commands here for the shift (use with caution):
```
# check replica status
replicactl status --region eu-west --replica-id r3
# tail recent errors
journalctl -u kv-replica.service -n 200
# attempt promote (dry-run first)
replica-promote --replica r3 --dry-run
```

Samir K: If the issue looks like a kernel OOM / GPU memory OOM (eng-runtime), page infra on-call and mention `oom-gpu` tag. For model-serving 503 spikes: check batching queue length and KV cache hit-rate first.

Alex M: On escalation contacts — please follow the paging order in this order: primary -> secondary -> oncall-lead -> infra-oncall -> eng-manager. If the customer is paying Dedicated/Private and it's impacting SLAs, page Hema and Priya immediately.

Jorge P: For handoff at 16:00 PST, I'll follow this checklist: 1) verify no unresolved sev2/1 alerts, 2) confirm outstanding pager counts are zero, 3) post final handoff note with primary/secondary for next shift, 4) leave quick runbook pointer in the channel.

Hema R: small policy tweak reminder — one human must be present on the signal for any Sev2 for first 10 minutes. If rotation causes a gap, escalate to oncall-lead immediately.

Alex M: I'll leave the handoff sticky in the channel 10m before I step away. If anyone gets paged and it's a customer-impacting regression, call out to #customer-impact and tag @Priya S so CS can prepare comms.

Priya S: confirmed; I'll prep a short template for customer comms in the runbook. Also if we see repeated flaps in 30m window, consider rollback of the 10:30 deploy (coordinate with deploy-bot and release owner).

oncall-bot: Incident policy note: To open an incident channel, react with :rotating_light: or run `/incident open <short reason>` — system will auto-invite primary, secondary, and oncall-lead.

Alex M: Thanks all — ping me directly if you need to escalate during my gap. I'll update the handoff message 10m before the calendar conflict. :thumbsup:
